sentences.text: Researchers constructed a specific artificial synapse by combining two oxides modified at their interface, creating a device that stably mimicked biological synapses by responding to both light and electricity.
When applied to train a computer program to read handwritten numbers, the system achieved 93.5 percent accuracy and automatically highlighted image edges by filtering out slow signal changes.
The authors suggest this approach offers a new method for building faster and more efficient computer chips that mimic the brain.
